title: Match is a Gaussian of z-scores against the trainer's residual σ; confidence is tree spread versus the seeds
context: 12-search-core.js scores each targeted metric as z = (pred − target)/σ with σ from the bundle's test residuals, combines them as score = exp(−zRms²/6), and discounts by tree spread relative to the median spread on training seeds (no cut up to 1.25×, falling off after, ×0.7 past 2×). Labels high/medium/low come from the same ratio.

options.name: z-score match plus spread penalty (current)
options.summary: Error-aware scoring with hand-set penalty breakpoints.
pros: Uses each metric's real model error, so weak metrics are scored loosely
Spread penalty stopped wide searches drifting into low-confidence designs (v0.4 recap)
cons: Global σ per metric, not per design

options.name: Per-design intervals (quantile forests or conformal)
options.summary: Predict an interval per candidate and score the probability of hitting the target band.
pros: Honest per-design uncertainty; replaces two mechanisms with one
cons: Trainer and bundle change; more compute per candidate

options.name: Nearest-neighbor distance to seeds for out-of-distribution
options.summary: README v0.2 plans mention a k-NN distance check.
cons: Distance in a padded feature space is a weak proxy

recommendation: 12-search-core.js scoreCandidate / spreadFactor / confidenceLabel; README "Confidence from tree spread"; v0.4 recap "Stricter confidence penalty" approved by Matt.
